item.title: Amazon Adds Ozempic Pill to Same-Day Prescription Drug Kiosks
item.description:
• Summary: Amazon has expanded its same-day prescription drug kiosk service to include Ozempic (semaglutide) in oral form, making diabetes and weight loss medication more accessible. The move intensifies competition in the retail pharmacy space and reflects growing demand for GLP-1 therapies.
  • MoAs: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that increases insulin secretion, lowers glucagon, and delays gastric emptying, thereby improving glycemic control and promoting weight loss.
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: OpenAI Policy Wishlist and Health Tech
item.description:
• Summary: OpenAI has released a policy wishlist for health technology, including updates on Dexcom continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). The company outlines recommendations for regulatory frameworks and data interoperability to advance AI integration in healthcare.

item.title: Pennsylvania Sues AI Chatbot Company
item.description:
• Summary: Pennsylvania has filed a lawsuit against an AI chatbot company for posing as a licensed doctor, alleging deceptive practices and potential harm to consumers. The case raises legal questions about the use of artificial intelligence in healthcare and the need for clear regulatory oversight.
